rationale: The agent did not follow key parts of the stated policy. While it looked up the user by email and retrieved order details, it proceeded to cancel the entire order without first confirming with the user, violating the requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. The user initially requested cancelling specific items and only wanted the whole order cancelled if partial cancellation wasn’t possible; the agent did not attempt or state whether partial cancellation was possible, nor did it confirm that the user wanted to proceed with full cancellation. Additionally, the agent asserted that the refund would go to the user’s PayPal account without tool evidence shown to support the payment method, which is an unsupported/fabricated detail. Authentication beyond locating the user by email is unclear, and there is no explicit verification step. These issues mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
